Human homeworld and Starfleet's political center.

How Earth connects

  • Work: Star Trek: First Contact — First Contact is fought over Earth's warp-flight past.
  • Faction: United Federation of Planets — The Federation's human capital sits on Earth.

What is Earth?

Earth is humanity's world, home of Starfleet Headquarters and the First Contact flight the Borg try to erase.

Key threads lead to Star Trek: First Contact and United Federation of Planets.
